# ⚡ Kubernetes Command of the Day (2026-08-16)

## 📌 Generate Clean Manifest via Client Dry-Run

```bash
kubectl create deployment demo-app --image=nginx:latest --dry-run=client -o yaml
```

| Metadata | Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Category** | `Yaml` |
| **Difficulty** | `Intermediate` |
| **Safety Rating** | **🟢 Safe** |
| **Verification Status** | Verified ✅ (Verified on local Kubernetes v1.30 environment.) |

---

### 📖 What It Does

Generates valid resource YAML without submitting the object to the Kubernetes API server.

### 💡 Why It Is Useful

Fastest way to create boilerplates without hand-typing YAML indentation.

### 💻 Practical Example

```bash
kubectl create deployment demo-app --image=nginx:latest --dry-run=client -o yaml > deployment.yaml
```

### Command Breakdown

- `--dry-run=client`: Format and validate manifest locally without sending HTTP request to cluster.
- `-o yaml`: Print output in standard YAML format.

### ⚙️ Prerequisites

Requires active `kubectl` connection and appropriate cluster permissions.

### ⚠️ Common Mistake

Running against the wrong namespace or context without checking current-context first.
